independence_statement: Saved before opening local spot, source, media or prior candidate records for these 25 names. Search/catalogue data selected candidates but did not establish acceptance.
method_limits: Coordinates are approximate discovery points and do not prove a launch.
Protected-area permission is unresolved unless an authority explicitly covers the sport and zone.
Image candidates are separate and none is approved by relevance alone.
Full draft/cloud duplication access remained unavailable.

spots.name: Apelviken
spots.identity: Apelviken's public surf beach south of Varberg.
spots.conditions: Long shallow horseshoe bay; S–NNW usable, W–NW preferred and onshore wind builds waves quickly.
spots.access_rules: Busy multi-use beach: riders must maintain safe separation from swimmers and each other; exact summer swim zoning remains open.
spots.trip_value: Sweden-leading multi-discipline beach, schools and year-round destination infrastructure justify worth_trip.

spots.name: Toppilansaari kitesurf beach
spots.identity: The sandy beach and breakwater at northern Toppilansaari, not Nallikari swimming beach.
spots.conditions: Bothnian Bay venue used on open water; nearby sea ice supports winter kite activity but is a separate risk state.
spots.access_rules: Exact launch, swimming separation and ice-safety regime need municipal confirmation.
spots.trip_value: Oulu access and unusual northern/seasonal setting support worth_trip after the entry is fixed.

sources.publisher: Visit Finland / Oulu City Tourist Info

spots.name: Hiekkasärkät, Kalajoki
spots.identity: Kalajoki Surf Center beach within the 3.5 km Hiekkasärkät area.
spots.conditions: Mostly shallow sand coast, but sudden deeps, currents and quickly changing waves occur around sandbanks.
spots.access_rules: No official lifeguards; use the Surf Center area and heed current/sudden-depth warnings.
spots.trip_value: Finland's largest surf center, instruction, rental and dune-resort setting support worth_trip.

spots.name: Svencelė
spots.identity: The established kite/sailing complex at Svencelės g. 49A on the Curonian Lagoon.
spots.conditions: Lagoon flat/chop with open meadows and established teaching areas; exact depth and nature-season constraints remain open.
spots.access_rules: Use the established centre and respect adjacent reserves; camping/parking follows operator rules.
spots.trip_value: Lithuania's strongest purpose-built wind-sports village has clear destination value but not enough global proof for world_class.

spots.name: Juodkrantė Beach
spots.identity: Juodkrantė's sport beach on the Curonian Spit; lagoon and Baltic sides must not be conflated.
spots.conditions: Wind-exposed Curonian setting; exact water side, bottom and wind window were not specified by official tourism.
spots.access_rules: Curonian Spit National Park and reserve rules apply; exact legal launch must be attached.
spots.trip_value: National-level kite reputation plus UNESCO landscape support worth_trip after identity/rules correction.

spots.name: Saulkrasti – Koklīte
spots.identity: The beach beside Koklīte café, not Saulkrasti's entire 17 km coast.
spots.conditions: Gulf of Riga wind-sport beach; depth begins closer to shore than at Jūrmala and conditions vary by wind.
spots.access_rules: Separate from Centre bathing beach; nearby Piejūra nature-park limits need an exact map.
spots.trip_value: Accessible Riga-region coast, defined gathering point and resort landscape support worth_trip after zoning confirmation.

spots.name: Ventspils South Beach
spots.identity: Proposed wind-sports area south of Ventspils city beach.
spots.conditions: Open Baltic sand beach; detailed wind, current and skill information comes only from a spot aggregator.
spots.access_rules: Current municipal sport corridor and bathing-season separation were not found.
spots.trip_value: City and coast have travel value, but sport-specific primary evidence is insufficient.

spots.name: Łeba / Sarbsko Lake
spots.identity: Sarbsko Lake school area near Łeba; the open Baltic beach is a separate venue.
spots.conditions: Lagoon/lake training water beside an exposed Baltic coast; exact depth and seasonal wind window remain open.
spots.access_rules: Launch must be pinned to a licensed school area and separated from port and national-park constraints.
spots.trip_value: Moving dunes, lake-and-sea choice, schools and resort services support worth_trip after launch correction.

spots.name: Jastarnia – Puck Bay
spots.identity: Bay-side Jastarnia riding areas around, but outside, the pier and fishing harbours.
spots.conditions: Very shallow sandy Puck Bay with fin/foil grounding risk and long downwind drift exposure.
spots.access_rules: Avoid pier, harbours, school teaching areas and marked bathing zones; current municipal kite ordinance remains unproven.
spots.trip_value: Dense school infrastructure and peninsula travel setting support worth_trip, distinct from Chałupy.

spots.name: Dąbki – Lake Bukowo
spots.identity: Water Sports Centre at Dąbkowicka 7 on Lake Bukowo, not the Baltic swimming beach.
spots.conditions: Lake venue with shallow and deeper sections; prevailing west/sea wind at the southeast-shore base.
spots.access_rules: Use the centre or verified private base; lake/sea connection and navigation require local briefing.
spots.trip_value: Modern instruction/rental plus a spa-and-sea destination support worth_trip.

spots.name: Viganj – Ponta Liberan
spots.identity: Ponta Liberan at Viganj in the Pelješac Channel.
spots.conditions: Daily summer mistral accelerated through the narrow channel; busy shared water and cross-channel traffic require local control.
spots.access_rules: Use school/rescue areas and current beach rules; the small launch must not be generalized to all Viganj shore.
spots.trip_value: World championship history, global visitors and Croatia-leading reputation exceed worth_trip.

spots.name: Premantura
spots.identity: Town-level Premantura candidate; no exact launch was established.
spots.conditions: Exposed Istrian peninsula with multiple coves; no authoritative spot-specific conditions were found.
spots.access_rules: Protected Kamenjak coast and exact permitted launch require authority confirmation.
spots.trip_value: Scenery is strong but the candidate is not yet a defensible spot record.

spots.name: Velika Plaža, Ulcinj
spots.identity: The established kite-school sections of 13 km Velika Plaža, excluding Ada Bojana island.
spots.conditions: Broad shallow sand beach with frequent 5–10 m/s summer mistral, main season May–October.
spots.access_rules: Use school/rescue sections; bathing and commercial beach concessions must be respected; no wild camping.
spots.trip_value: Official tourism calls it a leading European/global destination; it is beyond worth_trip.

spots.name: Ada Bojana
spots.identity: Island/delta-end candidate immediately adjacent to the Velika Plaža kite destination.
spots.conditions: Shares the same summer mistral system and sandy delta setting as Velika Plaža.
spots.access_rules: Exact independent public launch and separation from resort/naturist areas were not established.
spots.trip_value: Current evidence treats Ada as part of the same Ulcinj kite destination; do not count it as a second spot.

spots.name: Velipoja
spots.identity: Velipoja beach near the Buna mouth; no exact kite launch established.
spots.conditions: Very long, wide, gently shelving sandy coast beside protected wetland and river mouth.
spots.access_rules: Summer bathing areas and nearby protected habitats require mapping; sport proof is not authoritative.
spots.trip_value: Travel setting is plausible but dedicated wind-sport value is unproven.

spots.name: Krapets Beach
spots.identity: The broad Krapets beach south of Durankulak protected lake.
spots.conditions: Six-plus kilometre exposed Black Sea sand coast; waves and currents occur and most areas are unguarded.
spots.access_rules: Protect dunes and bird habitat; use legal access and verify seasonal conservation zones.
spots.trip_value: Remote natural coast and recognized Bulgarian wind-sport reputation support worth_trip after zone confirmation.

sources.publisher: Bulgarian beach guide using ministry data

spots.name: Asparuhovo Beach
spots.identity: Varna's Asparuhovo city beach between the sea-lake canal and Karantinata port.
spots.conditions: Wide, shallow, generally calm urban beach with heavy summer bathing and motor-water-sport use.
spots.access_rules: Any sail activity must use current marked access corridors and remain outside swimming areas.
spots.trip_value: Useful local training beach, but no compelling dedicated-trip value was established.

spots.name: Pomorie Lake / coast
spots.identity: Unresolved candidate spanning protected Pomorie Lake and adjacent sea coast.
spots.conditions: Salt-lake/coast setting with historic year-round use claims.
spots.access_rules: Ramsar material explicitly notes an official water-sport ban but the sentence/map is incomplete in accessible evidence.
spots.trip_value: Do not accept until the prohibited and permitted waters are resolved by a current authority.

spots.name: Mamaia – Lake Siutghiol
spots.identity: Lake-side nautical bases at Mamaia, not the crowded Black Sea bathing beach.
spots.conditions: Sheltered lake training water with multiple nautical operators; exact kite area and wind window remain open.
spots.access_rules: Use only ANR-approved recreation sectors and verified operators; separate from Black Sea swim zones.
spots.trip_value: Large resort infrastructure and lake/sea combination support worth_trip after the legal sector is attached.

spots.name: Corbu Beach
spots.identity: Unmanaged Corbu beach within the Danube Delta Biosphere Reserve.
spots.conditions: Wide, shallow natural beach with no lifeguard and sensitive dune/bird habitat.
spots.access_rules: Reserve permit, legal parking and no-camping/fire/overnight/vehicle rules apply; explicit non-motor wind-sport permission remains unclear.
spots.trip_value: Potential wild-coast value exists, but publication must wait for written activity permission and launch boundary.

sources.publisher: Pe Plaiuri, based on reserve rules

spots.name: Vadu Beach
spots.identity: The small permitted visitor sector at Vadu inside the Danube Delta Biosphere Reserve.
spots.conditions: Remote unguarded coast without water, toilets or rescue; protected dunes and Chituc strict zone lie nearby.
spots.access_rules: Permit required; no camping, overnight, vehicles on beach, fires or commercial activity. Wind-sport authorization was not proven.
spots.trip_value: Conservation/access uncertainty and absence of rescue make it unsuitable for counting now.

sources.publisher: Pe Plaiuri, based on reserve rules

spots.name: Alaçatı
spots.identity: Natural Alaçatı Port's annually designated windsurf courses.
spots.conditions: Very shallow, flat bay with reliable northern summer wind and extensive schools, May–October.
spots.access_rules: Use annually announced sport courses and current operator zones.
spots.trip_value: Official sources describe it as globally leading and host of premier international events; exclude as world_class.

sources.publisher: İzmir Provincial Directorate of Culture and Tourism

spots.name: Akyaka kite beach
spots.identity: Dedicated kite beach west of Akyaka in Gökova Bay, not the town swimming beach.
spots.conditions: Steady warm thermal/onshore wind, flat-to-small-chop sandy water and dense school infrastructure.
spots.access_rules: Paid/operator-controlled entries and separate wild lagoon require exact current zone rules.
spots.trip_value: National authority and operators present it as one of Turkey's and the world's most reliable kite centres; world_class boundary exceeded.

spots.name: Gökçeada – Aydıncık / Kefalos
spots.identity: Aydıncık and Kefalos wind-sport beach system on southern Gökçeada.
spots.conditions: Poyraz/lodos winds, flat and wave options, typically 15–25 kt in June–September.
spots.access_rules: The two beach sections need separate launch/level records; salt-lake habitat and current operator zones must be respected.
spots.trip_value: Island journey, dual conditions and established schools support worth_trip; global superlatives are not sufficiently independent for world_class.

spots.name: Gradina Beach
spots.identity: Gradina camping coast candidate south of Sozopol; exact launch unresolved.
spots.conditions: Open southern Black Sea beach; current discipline-specific conditions and hazards were not found.
spots.access_rules: Summer bathing/camping concessions and exact sport corridor require current local authority evidence.
spots.trip_value: A ministry guide names Gradina, but evidence is too generic to prove a trip-worthy spot.
